_comment: Discovery Pipeline configuration. Run with: python scripts/discovery_pipeline.py [--config path/to/config.json]

part4_reduction._comment_input: null = use Part 3 output (or Part 2 if Part 3 disabled/skipped). When running Part 4 standalone, set this to the rules.txt path.
part4_reduction._comment_source_data: Path to original JSONL or step6_rules_stats.json containing llm_input_renamed + point_coords. Required when Part 1/2 are disabled. null = auto-detect from {input.parent}/intermediates/step6_rules_stats.json (only works if Part 2 ran with save_intermediates=true in the same output_dir).
part4_reduction._comment_n_workers: Controls intra-group/intra-chunk parallelism for all sub-flows (seed/chunk/global reduction)
part4_reduction._comment_batch_size: Progress reporting granularity: print a progress log line every N rules processed. Does NOT affect reduction algorithm or parallelism.

seed_reduction._comment: Group-then-global reduction by seed field. Requires rules to have a seed field (error if none do). Groups processed serially; intra-group subsumption tests use n_workers.

chunk_reduction._comment_streaming_load: true = scan source JSONL once, reduce chunk-by-chunk without loading all rules into memory. Recommended for large datasets (>100K rules). Requires source_data. Cannot combine with seed_reduction. global_reduction runs at end of streaming pass when global_reduction.enabled=true.
chunk_reduction._comment: Chunked iterative reduction for large rule sets. Chunks processed serially; intra-chunk subsumption tests use n_workers.

global_reduction._comment: Full greedy subsumption on all (remaining) rules. Uses n_workers for parallel subsumption tests.
